value.answer: Tomorrow in Toronto looks showery and warm. Showers end around noon, then it's mostly cloudy with a 60% chance of showers and a risk of thunderstorms through the day. High of 24°C, with gusty southwest wind up to 40 km/h near noon, and 10 to 20 mm of rain possible. Tuesday night drops to a low of 12°C, still with a 60% chance of showers.
